first_principle: Backtest truth is the product. Speed is useful only after deterministic, causal, auditable classic-path equivalence is preserved.
primary_problem: The research engine is slow because each grid row repeats too much data loading, feature computation, state traversal, and bar-by-bar Python work across large stable and volatile panels.

compute_context.constraint: Worker count scaling is limited by memory duplication, disk IO, page cache pressure, volatile universe size, and Python object overhead.

classic_path_reference.rule: Every accelerated path must match the classic path before daemon production enablement.

attempted_architectures.name: more_workers
attempted_architectures.finding: Improves throughput only until memory and IO duplication dominate.

attempted_architectures.name: resource_controls_and_resume_safety
attempted_architectures.finding: Improves stability and recovery but does not materially reduce algorithmic work.

attempted_architectures.name: research_panel_loader
attempted_architectures.finding: Improves data quality and rich feature availability but increases panel width and load cost.

attempted_architectures.name: volatile_active_materialized_panel
attempted_architectures.finding: Correctly gates active membership but does not eliminate continuation and dynamic universe costs.

attempted_architectures.name: online_l7h1_adapter
attempted_architectures.finding: Passed metrics/equity parity with classic but delivered only modest speedup.

attempted_architectures.name: static_l7h1_columns_stable
attempted_architectures.finding: Coverage rebuilt successfully and produced 2x-4x speedups, but parity failed.

attempted_architectures.name: static_l7h1_columns_volatile
attempted_architectures.finding: Produced large speedups but failed parity because volatile membership and continuation windows are harder to reproduce.

attempted_architectures.name: sparse_context_candidate_paths
attempted_architectures.finding: Some stable tests passed parity with about 2x speedup; volatile benefits were limited.

attempted_architectures.name: columnar_candidate_event_framework
attempted_architectures.finding: Current implementation proved architecture hooks but did not yet remove dominant duplicated work.

recommended_architecture.name: certified_compiled_candidate_engine
recommended_architecture.principle: Move repeated feature and candidate work into one causal columnar grid-level pass, then let the classic engine remain authoritative for execution/accounting/artifacts.
